decisions.reason: The operator training programme builds directly on the firm's existing machine knowledge, enabling it to interpret early results and improve the offering.
The fourth rotary axis accessory is closely related to the firm's core machining products, giving high absorptive capacity to learn from market feedback.
Hybrid additive post-processing is less related to the firm's traditional subtractive machining knowledge, limiting its ability to assimilate and improve the product.
The high-speed CNC milling machine is a core product building on established CNC expertise, enabling strong interpretation and learning.
The automatic tool change system is a standard accessory within the firm's existing machine tool knowledge, supporting learning and improvement.
